hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); echo "$f" | grep -qE 'wrangler\.(jsonc|json|toml)$' || exit 0; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; if command -v fnm >/dev/null 2>&1; then fnm exec --using="$(cat .node-version 2>/dev/null || echo 22)" -- pnpm cf-typegen >&2 || true; else pnpm cf-typegen >&2 || true; fi
